paper_title: Extended Search for the Invisible Axion with the Axion Dark Matter Experiment
coupling_convention: g_agammagamma in GeV^-1, exactly as plotted on the y-axis
notes: ADMX Run 1B haloscope search, 680-790 MHz (2.81-3.31 ueV, combined with prior run gives 2.66-3.31 ueV DFSZ exclusion). New measured 90% CL exclusion on axion-photon coupling, reaching DFSZ sensitivity. No numerical table provided; limits shown only in Fig. 4. Data points emitted are the DFSZ coupling level g_agamma = (alpha/pi)*g_gamma/f_a with g_gamma=0.36, which the paper states is excluded across the range (assuming axions are 100% of DM). Gaps exist at 5 mode crossings (Table I: 704.659, 715.064, 717.025, 726.624, 753.844 MHz). Two DM models used: Maxwell-Boltzmann (rho=0.45 GeV/cm^3) and N-body (rho=0.63 GeV/cm^3); primary density reported is 0.45. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.85, 44)) | Vision: ADMX haloscope search, 680-800 MHz (2.81-3.31 ueV). Traced the jagged lower envelope of the 'This work' (green) exclusion region in Fig. 4. Dark green = Maxwell-Boltzmann lineshape limit (rho=0.45 GeV/cm^3); light green fringe extending slightly deeper = N-body lineshape limit (rho=0.63 GeV/cm^3); traced points follow the overall lower envelope. Gap in coverage at ~748-760 MHz (3.09-3.15 ueV) from a wide mode crossing at 753.844 MHz; narrower unset regions at 704.7, 715.1, 717.0, 726.6 MHz (Table I) not resolvable at this scale. KSVZ line reads ~1.1e-15 GeV^-1 at midpoint, DFSZ ~4.2e-16, consistent with abstract claim of excluding DFSZ. Steep rise of the limit near 800-803 MHz at the edge of the scan range. | Calibration: No calibration needed (spot-check verify/stage2 raw_ratio=1.17 snapped to identity)
